title: Introduce onboard transaction log and profile signature
author: Asha Menon
description:
Summary: Add an atomic transaction log for model onboarding events and attach compact cryptographic profile signatures to onboarding profiles. This change adds a write-ahead 'onboard_tx_log' table, an uploader-side transaction wrapper, and a lightweight signature scheme (profile_signature) used for traceable changelog digests and offline verification.
Motivation: onboarding has historically produced fragmented records (multiple metadata writes, sidecar profile uploads, async profile-calibration tasks) which made reconstructing a single coherent "onboard event" difficult for audits and changelogs. We need an atomic, compact record that captures the manifest, profile pointers, provenance hashes, and a signature so downstream release-note automation can create deterministic digests.
Design:
- New DB migration to create onboard_tx_log with columns: tx_id, model_id, actor, timestamp, manifest_hash, profile_id, profile_signature, status, metadata_blob_ref.
- Uploader changes: wrap model+profile upload steps in a transaction that writes a tx log row in status=PENDING, performs existing upload steps, computes a compact profile_signature (ed25519 over canonical profile JSON + manifest_hash), updates the tx row to COMMITTED.
- Change hook: add a release-note digester that consumes committed tx rows and emits compact changelog entries (JSONL) for the changelog pipeline.
- Backfill tool: best-effort backfill that reconstructs tx rows for recent uploads using manifests and profile-history when available; backfill is non-blocking and tagged.
- Tests: unit tests for signature generation, integration test that simulates a failed upload and ensures tx status remains PENDING/ROLLED_BACK as appropriate.
